description: Retest of S3b cancel with projection-visibility-aware wait. Establishes that the cancel endpoint has two distinct defects.

outcome_after_cancel.interpretation: Phase ran the full 18s as if no cancel had been issued. The cancel signal was acknowledged at the HTTP layer but the interactive-tmux agent loop did not honor it.

defects_surfaced.title: Control-plane Cancel is silently ignored on interactive-tmux executions
defects_surfaced.evidence: HTTP returns 200 success=true message='Cancel signal queued' but the phase still runs to its natural ~18s completion; no interrupt was honored.

defects_surfaced.title: Cancel returns 404 during 4.5s projection-visibility lag after submit
defects_surfaced.evidence: POST /executions/{eid}/cancel returns 'Execution not found' for several seconds after the submit response carrying that eid, because the cancel route resolves via the workflow_execution_details projection.
